Name: Curves of Affection and Valley Girls Pretty Anime Portraits (APF) Compatibility Patch
Author: Alex3108
Description:
Overview
This is a small compatibility patch for mods using [b]Animated Portrait Framework (APF)[/b].
APF portrait packs can overwrite each other when multiple packs edit the same NPC. This patch merges the portrait definitions into a single APF pack so the three mods can work together.
[b]Important:[/b] This patch includes [b]only[/b]
[code]content.json[/code]and
[code]manifest.json[/code]. It does [b]not[/b] include any portraits or other assets. You must download the original mods and copy their portrait files into this patch folder.
What this patch does
[list]
[*]Merges portrait configs so you can use these three APF packs together:
[list]
[*] [b]Curves of Affection [/b][/*]
[*][b]Valley Girls Pretty Anime Portraits[/b] [/*]
[*][b]Animated NON-Marriageable Female Portraits[/b] [/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]Notes / Known issues
[list]
[*]This is an unofficial patch and may be [b]buggy[/b] depending on your mod setup (UI mods, scaling mods, other portrait packs, etc.). [/*]
[*]If a specific portrait expression is not called by a dialogue/event script, you may not see it in-game (this is normal for APF). [/*]
[/list]Credits
All portrait artwork belongs to the original authors.
This patch only provides a merged configuration to improve compatibility.

[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install all requirements (links below). [/*]
[*]Install this patch into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Copy the [b]Portraits[/b] folders/assets from the required mods into this patch folder (follow the instructions included with the patch). [/*]
[*][b]Valley Girls Pretty Anime Portraits requires an extra step:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resize its portrait images to [b]512×512[/b] (and any related sprite sheets to the same 50% scale) before copying, because this patch uses 512px frame size. [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Disable the original APF packs (optional but recommended to avoid conflicts), and keep [b]only the patch[/b] enabled as the active merged APF pack.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Curves of Affection — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43802]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43802[/url] [/*]
[*]Valley Girls Pretty Anime Portraits — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44253]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44253[/url] [/*]
[*]Animated NON-Marriageable Female Portraits — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43520]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43520[/url][/*]
[/list]
